gold_dart.subject: Seen from behind in silhouette, a lone human knight in plain steel armor made of a few large smooth plates with a faded blue tabard and a plain round steel helmet stumbles backwards with his shield raised. One large flat gold coin with a sharp edge spins through the air toward him in a streak of bright yellow light and bursts against his shield in a small spray of orange sparks. A dark stone wall stands behind him.

coin_swarm.subject: Five large flat gold coins hover in the air in a loose diagonal line, each tilted on its edge and spinning, with the nearest coin large in the frame. Each coin trails a short curved streak of yellow light behind it, and a single scattered handful of smaller gold coins lies on the dusty ground below. A pile of grey rocks stands behind them.

gold_rain.subject: A lone human knight in plain steel armor made of a few large smooth plates with a faded blue tabard and a plain round steel helmet, crouching low and holding his round wooden shield over his head. A heavy shower of thick glowing orange liquid gold pours down from the top of the frame onto the shield and splashes into a wide shining puddle around his boots. Orange fire and glowing embers drift up from the puddle.

gilded_golem.subject: A single huge golem made of smooth solid gold in a few large blocky plates stands planted with its feet apart and both thick arms hanging at its sides, its round head a plain smooth block with one dark slit. A heap of gold coins lies around its feet, and it throws one large soft shadow on the ground. A grey cave wall stands behind it with a little golden dust drifting up.

hoard_dragon.subject: A huge ancient dragon with smooth golden-yellow skin, a pale cream belly, long curved horns and a smooth frill rises on its hind legs with its wings spread wide, its head lowered and its mouth open. A broad mountain of gold coins fills the bottom of the frame and gold coins slide off the mound where the dragon stands. A dark cavern wall stands behind it.
